lots.guide_summary: All sold: four close Gowans results for wide plain live-edge myrtle slabs in July 2026, $35, $55, $60 and $110 hammer (median about $57). No unsold or asking evidence survived. Wider context: plain myrtle slabs at Gowans have ranged $10 to $125 in 2026, with narrower boards in Sep making only $13 to $20, so the market is soft and depends heavily on size. All AUD, no conversion.
lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD = $35 (lot 1104, 12 Jul 2026). 35 / 1.198 = 29.2, round down to $25 (all-in $29.95). Flip: likely resale about $55 hammer at a Gowans-style sale (median of close sales), less an assumed 20% vendor commission/fees and $0 postage (pickup sale) = $44. 44 / 2.396 = 18.4, round down to $15. Flip margin is tiny, so this is a keep-for-use buy only. Inbound freight $0 (pickup from 37 Main Road, Moonah).
lots.confidence_reason: Clear photo, Gowans title gives the species, and four close SOLD results whose API records and photos I opened. Not High because sizes and species are unconfirmed and comparisons are by eye only.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped researcher's UNSOLD entry (the six 18 Oct 2026 'SLAB OF MYRTLE' lots, ids 445935 to 445940, are THIS sale and still open, sale_price 0 means not yet sold, so it is not unsold evidence; they already show 0 to 2 absentee bids). Dropped blackwood slab entry (different species, category noise). Replaced the researcher's aggregated range entries (for example '$10 to $55, 16 lots') with individual lots whose photos I checked, because the aggregates mixed narrow sawn boards, figured and two-slab lots with wide live-edge slabs. Tiger/figured ($60, $110) and '2 SLABS' ($180) lots dropped as not comparable to plain single slabs.
lots.key_photo_findings: Chalk '1106 23/10/26' and lot sticker 1106 read. Live edge both sides with bark remnants and a deep waist on the right, frayed/split fibres at the top end, a few small knots and a small end check at the bottom. No obvious figure. Standing beside 1107 and 1108 from the same vendor.
lots.condition: Rough-sawn, unfinished, sound-looking face with minor end checking and bark inclusions on the edges. Dryness unknown.
